stem.en: An object starts at position 0 m and moves at a constant velocity of 4 m/s. Plot its position-time graph from t = 0 s to t = 5 s.

explanation.en: At a constant velocity of 4 m/s, the position grows by 4 m every second: 4 m at 1 s, 8 m at 2 s, 12 m at 3 s. The points lie on a straight line through the origin.

hints.en: Position = velocity x time. Where is the object at 1 s, 2 s and 3 s?
